scope: Native persistent ASGI/SQLite composition, bounded Ingress leases, fixed-origin CSRF and shared household services; package and owner installation unchanged
environment: Python 3.14.6; loopback protocol fixtures require local socket permission. The restricted-sandbox attempt was not accepted as a pass; the complete socket-enabled run passed.
assertions: Only the actual Supervisor peer, exactly one subject/base path and one valid upstream session cookie reach protected routes; no client metadata alone creates human proof
Keyed bindings include installation UUID, channel, human and Ingress path; raw cookies do not enter persistent data or diagnostic representations
Safe reads establish a lease only after exact fresh HA proof; existing fresh reads retain the original absolute deadline
Bounded HA availability failure permits existing local reads only until that deadline; writes require fresh proof and cannot bootstrap from CSRF
Explicit rejection invalidates local access; later outage cannot resurrect it; shutdown blocks late bootstrap and clears bindings
Concurrent bootstrap preserves one original lease and failed conditional refresh denies access
Fixed configured origins are validated before SQLite; supplied forwarding headers cannot change accepted origins
CSRF is bound to the local lease epoch and exact installation/channel/session/human/path; restart and changed upstream session cannot reuse it
Shared household setup/enrollment/member/policy/query services preserve transactional authority, idempotency and receipt/audit/outbox behavior
Selected ordinary HA human can administer Domus through the configured mapping while remaining non-administrator in HA; Core directory privilege is transport only
Injected response failure after commit preserves uncertainty and identical retry recovers exactly one result
Actual native OpenAPI paths/components match the published contract; private process health and preview behavior remain separate
schema: Business schema 2 unchanged; no upstream cookie, technical token, local session lease or CSRF is persisted
